title: Topic 5: Feelings & States - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Say how you feel; ask others how they feel

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Handwritten note format
NOTE FOR MY MOTHER
Good morning, Mama!
I am at school. I am fine and happy.
My sister is very tired - she is in bed.
Her friend Tina is here.
- Kisses, Duda

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Rafa: Hi Gil! Are you happy today?
Gil:  No, I am not. I am sad and tired.
Rafa: Oh no! Why?
Gil:  I am hungry and my house is very cold!
Rafa: Come to my house! We are happy here.

readingQuestions.question: What is this text?
options: A note from Duda to her mother
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: A note from Duda to her mother
